title: IntoIterator on slice reference borrows
prompt: What item type do you get when iterating over &Vec<T> with a for loop?
answer: Iterating over `&Vec<T>` calls `IntoIterator` on the reference, which yields shared references `&T`. The vector is borrowed for the duration of the loop and remains usable afterwards. Iterating over an owned `Vec<T>` consumes the vector and yields owned `T` items.
